name: Pax8 CLI Demo
postCreateCommand: npm i -g pnpm && pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm link --global packages/cli
postStartCommand:
echo '
  ✨ Pax8 CLI is ready in demo mode!

  Try these commands:
    pax8 status
    pax8 companies list
    pax8 subscriptions list
    pax8 recommendations list
    pax8 status --all
'
